### How to Illuminate Your World with the Gospel
Author: Dr. Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-march-22-2013.html
Passage: 1 Peter 2:9
Points:
- Christians are needed across all ordinary vocations and secular workplaces, not solely in full-time church work.
- God strategically places believers in challenging secular environments where temptation exists so they can live for Him.
- Believers are called out of darkness to shine as lights and point others to Jesus right where they are.
- Believers must rely on God daily to give them the strength to obey His commands and share the Gospel.

### Pure Spiritual Milk
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pure-spiritual-milk
Passage: 1 Peter 2:1-3
Points:
- Pursuing Christian holiness requires putting away harmful attitudes like malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
- Genuine spiritual growth requires an insatiable longing for the pure spiritual milk of God's Word.
- In this context, spiritual milk refers to the nourishing whole of divine revelation rather than merely elementary doctrines.
- Believers must examine their appetite for Scripture and ask God to increase their hunger to study and apply His truth.
